newsitem.title: USA: Sigma Designs wins part of Army contract.
newsitem.headline: Sigma Designs wins part of Army contract.

text.p: Sigma Designs Inc Monday said its REALmagic' MPEG accelerator has been selected by BTG Inc for its indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity US Army purchase contract for technologically advanced personal computers, related hardware and software.

In a statement, Sigma said BTG is one of two contractors selected for the US Army's PC-2 program. The contract is for $554 million over two years, and enables the Army to acquire commercial-off-the-shelf personal computers with performance at either Pentium 166 or Pentium Pro 200 level.
Sigma Designs' MPEG accelerators offer proprietary Analog Overlay technology for full-screen, full-motion MPEG video and compatibility with any VGA graphics.
